description: 2026-10-04 review (speculative): session.rs ~5061 - closed() resets the flag on a real close, but if the shell never closes the window (ShutWindow finds none), it stays closing: it answers Ok without closing and is left out of the staying count, so closing the other of two windows is refused as the only one.
